text.content:
A Gilded alcove, quiet enough that it's clearly been used as a waypoint by more than one previous expedition.

GM Notes

Substory beat: A half-transmuted survivor is trapped between forms in a side chamber, begging for the process to be reversed or finished.

Hazard: A pressure plate near the threshold triggers a hidden mechanism unless disarmed (DC 13 to notice, DC 13 to disarm).
